scope: Close the local DXF XDATA group-1004 physical chunk-boundary gap identified in 7K, without adding a drawing fixture or promoting external support claims.

formatReference.observation: Autodesk documents group 1004 binary data as variable-length chunks with a maximum of 127 bytes per chunk; ASCII DXF represents each byte as two hexadecimal digits.

method.kind: Source-generated ASCII and Binary DXF writer/readback controls
method.temporaryOutput: Generated ASCII/Binary DXF outputs were written under the system temporary directory and removed after the test.

assertions: Raw code-1004 tag contains exact uppercase hexadecimal bytes.
Readback preserves the APPID and exact binary chunk content.
The following LINE is parsed with its expected coordinates and no XDATA.
Export succeeds at the physical group-1004 chunk limit.
Raw and decoded chunk bytes match exactly.
The following LINE remains aligned and readable.
Export splits the payload into two physical group-1004 chunks.
Raw and decoded chunk ordering/content match the source bytes exactly.
The following LINE remains aligned and readable.

doesNotEstablish: independent producer or native CAD acceptance
a drawing-wide XDATA or DWG EED size limit
broader DWG/DXF feature completeness or support parity

planImpact.nextSlice: Generated DWG EED writer-size boundaries around 32,767/32,768 and 65,535/65,536 encoded bytes, kept distinct from DXF 1004 and resource limits.
